description: This file defines the `SignificantLocationMonitor` enum with a static method `startIfNeeded` that initiates monitoring of significant location changes using CoreLocation, constructs a JSON payload with location data, and sends `location.update` events to a gateway. It manages location authorization, encodes location data, and performs callback execution before sending the event.

methods.name: startIfNeeded
methods.description: Checks location authorization and mode, then starts significant location change monitoring. When location updates occur, it encodes location info into JSON and sends an event to the gateway, optionally executing a callback before sending.
